1637313760116318208.a: Regardless of type of gizmo the radio detector is a piece of crystal stuffed deep inside. These two rocks are what a radio detector looks like in nature. Either of these can be connected to microscopic probes and resonators (antennas) tuned to some wavelength.

1637319144709271552.a: Taking this one step further... Why is the base called a base? Because it is the metal base that the crystal is glued to. With careful oxidization of metals, more precise manufacturing, and a second probe this becomes a transistor. Radio detection is a diode with probe E and Base t.co
